title: Special Executive Programme In Fundamentals Of Risk Management
description: Explore the core principles and methodologies of risk management, focusing on operational risk in financial contexts.
longDescription: This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of operational risk, its significance, and various management approaches. Participants will learn about risk models, including the Black-Scholes Model, and the Basel Accords' frameworks for effective risk assessment.
courseDetails: The Concept of the Black Scholes Model. The Assumptions of the Black Scholes Merton Model. Various Risk Models. The Concept of the Ellsberg Paradox. Various Examples of Black Swan Events. Mathematical Models of Risk. The Elements of D.F.A. The Concept of Operational Risk and its Significance in Financial Management. Identify and Differentiate Between the Various Categories of Operational Risk in a Banking Context. The Different Approaches to Assess and Manage Operational Risk in Banking Operations. The Principles and Key Aspects of the Standardised Approach for Operational Risk Management. Quantitative Standards When Utilising the Advanced Measurement Approach (Ama) for Operational Risk Management. The Different Types of Credit Risk Assessment Approaches Used in Banking and Their Respective Implications. The course begins with an exploration of operational risk, including its definition, types, and the foundational principles of operational risk management. Participants will examine the Basel Accords, particularly Basel II, and its event types related to operational risk. The programme covers various risk models, including the Black-Scholes Model, and introduces key concepts like the Ellsberg Paradox and Black Swan events. Lastly, it emphasizes different approaches to assessing and managing operational risk in banking, focusing on standardized and advanced measurement approaches. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following: Understanding the concept of Operational Risk: Understanding The Risk Models: Standards And Approaches Of Operational Risks:
